title: [Run] Hangs when enumerating directories with lots of entries
author: riverar
summary: The inbox Windows WinUI 3 Run dialog enumerates more than 140,000 WinSxS entries and hangs, but the reporter confirms this is not PowerToys Run.

confidence.rationale: The reporter and maintainer explicitly identify the external product boundary.

judgment.rationale: The failing executable is the Windows inbox Run dialog, and a PowerToys maintainer explicitly tracks it through an internal Windows work item. PowerToys cannot independently ship the inbox fix.
evidence: The reporter clarified that the failure is in the WinUI 3 inbox Run dialog, not PowerToys Run or Command Palette.
The affected directory contains about 143,287 entries and the inbox UI consumes about 1 GiB while enumerating.
A maintainer linked an internal Windows work item and described PowerToys icon-cache work as code the inbox owner may ingest.
PowerToys PR 49738 later merged related in-flight icon-load/cache improvements, but it does not itself update the inbox Windows Run package.
judgment.recommended_action: Leave ownership with the Windows Run team and use its feedback/internal tracking path; do not start a separate PowerToys product fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A new PowerToys repository fix is not applicable because the failing product is the inbox Windows Run dialog and its owner already has internal tracking.

issue_context.summary: The inbox Windows WinUI 3 Run dialog enumerates more than 140,000 WinSxS entries and hangs, but the reporter confirms this is not PowerToys Run.
known_information: The issue is labeled External Dependency and CmdPal - Shell.
The reporter reproduced on Windows build 26300.8346.
PowerToys PR 49738 merged on 2026-08-07 and separates in-flight icon loading from cached results.
inferences: The inbox implementation may share or ingest parts of the PowerToys shell/icon-loading code, but repository merge status is not proof that the Windows package has consumed it.
issue_context.analysis: The report is useful to the shared engineering team, but the shippable defect is outside the PowerToys repository. A PowerToys dashboard fix proposal would misstate ownership.
initial_investigation: Read all six comments and labels.
Inspected cross-referenced PR 49738 and confirmed it is merged but does not close this issue or ship the inbox Run dialog.
